title: Length and evaluation of the pair wire list
statement: For every natural number $n$ and bit string $r$, the pair wire list has length $2n+2+|r|$. Moreover, for every assignment $v:	ext{Fin}(n)	o	ext{Bool}$, replacing each variable wire by its value and each constant wire by that constant gives the self-delimiting pairing of the bit string $(v(0),\ldots,v(n-1))$ with $r$.
hypotheses_covered: $v$ is an assignment of a Boolean value to each of the $n$ variables
